title: secDevLabs SaidaJaula Monster Fit
description: A Flask site for a gym, backed by MariaDB, with member registration, login and an admin route. The session cookie holds the member's name and permission level, signed only with a plain SHA-256 of its own content.
question: Forge a session cookie that makes the site treat you as an admin and open /admin. The flag is in /ctf/flag.
